notes.title: DAEMON X MACHINA Complete DLC Bundle Available Now
notes.content:
With the influx of new Arsenal pilots comes the desire to stand out from the crowd. Though there are plenty of ways to customize your pilot and Arsenal in the base game, there’s even more modification options available as DLC. To help spark those imaginations, we’ve created an all-new bundle that collects more than 55 different options for players to set themselves apart from the crowd. From suits and emotes to hairstyles and decals, you’ll have no shortage of options to make an impression. 

To make things even more enticing, while the bundle would normally be available for $41.21 – a 30% discount off the combined individual purchase prices – we're going even deeper on those discounts for one week only. From March 23 through March 30, you can get the [i]DAEMON X MACHINA[/i] “Complete DLC Bundle” at an additional 40% off. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749840/DAEMON_X_MACHINA__Complete_DLC_Bundle/

While looking good is the main goal, we also hope this will enhance your enjoyment of the original [i]DAEMON X MACHINA[/i] while you wait for the recently announced sequel, [i]Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion[/i], to arrive on September 5. Don’t forget to wishlist now to stay informed and prepare to suit up once more this fall. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342490/Daemon_X_Machina_Titanic_Scion/

notes.title: Save 80% on DAEMON X MACHINA
notes.content:
From now until May 12, you can experience the adrenaline-fueled mech action of [i]DAEMON X MACHINA [/i]at its lowest price ever -- $9.99! That makes this week the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the world that visionary producer Kenichiro Tsukuda created, and trailblazing mechanical designer Shoji Kawamori helped bring to life, ahead of the release of the recently announced sequel, [i]Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion[/i]. 

While you wait for that sequel, you can take advantage of this deal on [i]DAEMON X MACHINA[/i] to satisfy your mech game itch, whether you want to play solo or team up with some friends in cooperative play. If you’re feeling particularly froggy, you test your mettle in PVP to see if you’re really the pilot you think you are. 

All this should prepare you for the expanded experience that awaits in [i]Titanic Scion[/i]. Coming September 5, this sequel takes the franchise in a dramatic new direction. You can learn more about Titanic Scion by checking out the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1342490/view/542230409777250607?l=english] new “Combat Basics” trailer[/url], which showcases some of the customizable armaments you can equip on your Arsenal, as well as some of the epic enemies that await. Then wishlist the game so you’re in the know when more details are revealed! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342490/Daemon_X_Machina_Titanic_Scion/

notes.title: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion Arrives Worldwide on September 5, 2025
notes.content:
The action-packed sequel to [i]Daemon X Machina[/i] is coming to PC this September! 

From creator and producer Kenichiro Tsukuda, and featuring stunning mechanical designs from Shoji Kawamori, [i]Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion[/i] takes the franchise in a dramatic new direction. Whether alone or with up to two friends, you can experience fast-paced combat in your customizable Arsenal. Freely explore a deadly and dangerous open world on land or in the air and take your place in the battle for humanity’s liberation. 

Check out the announcement trailer below: 

[previewyoutube=GdVh2wTacdg;full][/previewyoutube]

You can wishlist now and stay tuned for more details ahead of the September 5 release! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342490/Daemon_X_Machina_Titanic_Scion/

Be sure to follow the official X account [url=https://x.com/dxm_game]here[/url] and stay informed with updates on the [url=https://na.daemonxmachina.com/titanicscion/]official site[/url].

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.6
notes.content:
Update Details:
- Fixed an issue where a player was sent to a different room from the room they chose to join in the online modes. This fix also addresses infinite loading and errors caused by the issue.
- Fixed an issue where the Crusader DLC skin was unlocked for everyone and the unlock message displayed every time the game is launched.

notes.title: Mech brawler Daemon X Machina is free to keep next week
notes.content: Daemon X Machina hit PC in early 2020, following roughly six months spent as a Nintendo Switch exclusive. It's a third-person mech combat game developed by Marvellous, and while it's definitely worth a shot if you're into anime and mechs, it does get quite repetitive, according to our review... Read more.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.4
notes.content:
Update Details:
- Fixed an issue where save data imported with the cross-save feature under certain circumstances would not be reflected correctly

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.3
notes.content:
Update Details:
- Save data compatibility between Nintendo Switch™ and Steam (cross-save feature) has been added.

When uploading data from your Nintendo Switch system, data on the Steam Cloud will be overwritten and any progress on Steam will be lost.

Furthermore, the following will not be carried over:
- Options settings
- Language settings
- Dialogue text that has been edited in chat settings
- Downloadable content

notes.title: Patch notes 2/24/20
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Daemon X Machina.
Build Number: 4696025

This update addresses the following issues:
-Voice language reverts to English upon restarting the game even if previously set to Japanese
-Gargoyle statue cannot be destroyed at high frame rates

[i]If you are experiencing a "UE4 Fatal Error" crash and use an AMD graphics card, please update your graphics driver. We've found that this solves the issue for most people. If you've tried this and are still receiving the error, please email us with details at support@xseedgames.com[/i]

notes.title: Post-apocalyptic mech shooter Daemon X Machina is coming to PC from Switch
notes.content:
Do you like high speed mech battles, lots of explosions, and high-contrast colour schemes? Well this is what Daemon X Machina has in store for you. The third-person mech shooter is ending its Switch exclusivity to arrive on PC next Thursday, February 13th, bringing all of its glorious destructive action to Steam.
